from math import ceil
from typing import List

def matrixfy(name: str) -> List[List[str]]:
    if len(name) == 0:
        return "name must be at least one letter"
    n = ceil(len(name) ** 0.5)
    matrix = [[name[i * n + j] if i * n + j < len(name) else '.' for j in range(n)] for i in range(n)]
    return matrix
